title: alnus incana var. angulata
intro: Alnus incana var. angulata, commonly known as the narrow-leaved alder, is a variant of the green alder plant, known for its distinctive narrow leaves. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and protect against infections. The therapeutic actions of Alnus incana var. angulata include its ability to act as a demulcent, astringent, and expectorant, making it useful for treating respiratory issues and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
